svg.title: Cushing pump price observation
svg.desc: At Maverik 5097 in Cushing on 2026-09-08, regular gasoline credit price was 3.799 dollars per gallon and diesel credit price was 5.499 dollars per gallon. The diesel premium was 1.700 dollars per gallon. This is one local observation, not a historical correlation.
svg.text: Cushing Pump Board · first public local observation
Maverik #5097 · 2001 E Main St · observed 2026-09-08 · credit price / gallon
Single-station, single-date snapshot: price gap is descriptive only; no correlation is calculated.
A Cushing–WTI relation requires dated local prices at fixed stations over time. National or Oklahoma averages are not substituted.
